FN-VF6XPP-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 210
Committee: Military and Veterans Affairs Sponsor: Representative Rhett Marques
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 04/10/2023
House Bill 210 as introduced could reduce potential insurance premium tax receipts to the State
General Fund by a small, undetermined amount dependent on the amount of active-duty
members that purchase motor vehicle liability coverage in another state, pursuant to the
exemption provided by this bill.
